ST — Research Configuration

Purpose

This page defines the functional, research-control and interface requirements for the Research Configuration support module within the TOTALFLOW Compliance Intelligence Engine (Semantic Reasoning Research Platform).
This is not a general SaaS settings page and is not a marketing page. It is an internal R&D control used to define the technical environment under which Experiments E1–E6 are executed, compared and reproduced.

Suggested Page Design

How and Why This Page Must Work

Why the Page Exists

The research results cannot be interpreted reliably unless the technical configuration used for each experiment run is known and preserved.
The Research Configuration page controls:
Model-provider authentication
Vision model selection
Reasoning model selection
Currency treatment
Connection validation
Experiment-result export
Experiment-result deletion
A change to any of these settings may affect future experiment results. Every completed run must therefore retain the exact configuration used at execution time.

Core Research-Control Principle

Configuration changes apply only to future experiment runs.
Every experiment result must record:
Vision model
Reasoning model
Model provider
Currency treatment
Configuration version or snapshot
Date and time of execution
Experiment run identifier
Existing experiment results must remain linked to their original configuration even after the active settings are changed.

Required Configuration States

The page must clearly distinguish between:
Saved — the current controls match the stored research configuration.
Unsaved Changes — one or more settings have been changed but not saved.
Connection Verified — the API key and selected models have passed a connection test.
Connection Failed — the provider or selected model could not be reached.
Validation Error — a required setting is missing or invalid.
Results Available — one or more saved experiment-run records are available for export.
No Results Available — there are no saved experiment-run records to export or delete.

Page Classification

Module Type: Research Support Module
Navigation Label: ST: Research Configuration
Research Role: Experiment Environment Controller
Relationship to Experiments: Defines the shared technical configuration used by E1–E6
This page must not be numbered as another experiment because it does not test a hypothesis. It controls the environment in which the experiments are executed.

Page Title

ST: Research Configuration

Page Description

Configure the model-provider connection, experiment models, currency treatment and saved-result controls used across the research programme. Changes apply to future experiment runs and must be recorded to preserve reproducibility.

Recommended Page Layout

The page should use the same restrained R&D interface established for E1–E6, Ground Truth Annotation and the Policy Editor.
It must contain:
Page title and description
Page Guide button
Research-control notice
Current configuration status
Model and input configuration
Connection controls
Experiment-result management
Destructive-action warning
Configuration traceability note
The page must not contain decorative artwork, marketing graphics, a website-style hero image or promotional benefit statements.

Page Guide Control

Button

Page Guide
The button must appear near the top of the page and open a modal explaining the purpose and effect of every control.

Current Configuration Status

The page should display a compact research status summary before the form.
Recommended fields:
Configuration Status
Connection Status
Vision Model
Reasoning Model
Currency Treatment
Last Saved
Saved By
Configuration Version
Example:
Configuration Status: Saved
Connection Status: Verified
Vision Model: google/gemini-2.5-flash
Reasoning Model: google/gemini-2.5-flash
Currency Treatment: Receipt Currency
Configuration Version: v1.3

Research-Control Notice

Display prominently:
Research Control: Configuration changes apply only to future experiment runs. Every completed run must retain the exact model, provider, currency treatment and configuration version used when it was executed.

Experiment Configuration

The current heading Model Configuration should be replaced with:
Experiment Configuration
This is more accurate because the page controls models, authentication, currency treatment and experiment-result management.
The form should be divided into two subsections:
Model and Input Configuration
Experiment Result Management

Model and Input Configuration

OpenRouter API Key

Field label: OpenRouter API Key
Purpose:
Authenticates requests sent to the selected model provider.
Behaviour:
Display the value as masked.
Provide a show/hide control.
Do not include the API key in experiment-result exports.
Do not display the complete key in logs or error messages.
Clearly state where the key is stored.
Current storage note:
Stored in browser local storage. Re-entry may be required after switching browsers, clearing browser data or changing devices.
For stronger research governance, the system should later support secure server-side secret storage rather than relying solely on browser local storage.

Vision Model — Layer 1

Field label: Vision Model (OCR — Layer 1)
Purpose:
Selects the model used for document understanding and structured extraction in E1.
Current options:
google/gemini-2.5-flash (recommended)
qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
Research significance:
Changing the Vision Model may alter the structured accounting data produced by E1 and therefore affect all later experiments that rely on E1 output.
Each E1 result must record the exact Vision Model used.

Reasoning Model — Layer 3

Field label: Reasoning Model (Verdict — Layer 3)
Purpose:
Selects the model used for policy interpretation, reasoning, uncertainty handling and verdict generation in E2–E6.
Current options:
google/gemini-2.5-flash (recommended)
qwen/qwen2.5-72b-instruct
mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-instruct
anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
Research significance:
Switching models enables controlled comparison of model behaviour across E2–E6.
Each result must record the exact Reasoning Model used.

Currency Override

Field label: Currency Override
Purpose:
Controls whether the system uses the currency detected on the receipt or substitutes a selected currency in experiment prompts.
Current options:
Any (use receipt currency)
AUD
USD
EUR
Required interpretation:
Any means preserve the currency extracted from the receipt.
A selected currency forces that currency treatment for future experiment prompts.
The chosen currency treatment must be recorded in every affected experiment run.

Connection Controls

Save Settings

Button label: Save Settings
Helper text:
Save this configuration for future experiment runs.
Save behaviour:
Validate all required settings.
Save the active configuration.
Create or increment the configuration version.
Record the user and timestamp.
Confirm that the saved configuration applies only to future runs.
Preserve previous run linkage to earlier configurations.

Test Connection

Button label: Test Connection
Purpose:
Verifies that the API key and selected provider configuration can reach the required model service.
Successful state:
Connection verified
The API key and selected model configuration are responding successfully.
Failure state:
Connection failed
The provider or selected model could not be reached. Review the API key, model availability and provider response.
A failed connection test must not expose the API key.

Experiment Result Management

The current heading Experiment Results should remain, but the actions must be made more precise.

Export Experiment Results

Replace:
Export All Results (JSON)
with:
Export Experiment Results
Helper text:
Export all retained E1–E6 experiment-run records and supporting research metadata as JSON.
The export should include, where available:
Experiment identifier
Run identifier
Run date and time
Receipt or source-document reference
Extracted accounting fields
Policy identifier, name, variant and version
Project phase
Vision model
Reasoning model
Provider
Currency treatment
Configuration version
Verdict
Supporting reason
Confidence values
Ambiguity indicators
Hallucination or reliability indicators
Raw model response, where retained
The export must not include:
API keys
Authentication secrets
Browser storage values unrelated to experiment results

Delete Experiment Results

Replace:
Clear All Results
with:
Delete Experiment Results
The action must delete saved E1–E6 experiment-run outputs only.
It must not delete:
Ground-truth annotations
Policies or policy versions
Research configuration settings
API credentials
Source receipt files, unless separately and explicitly selected
Documentation

Delete Confirmation

The confirmation modal must display:
Number of experiment runs to be deleted
Experiments affected
Data categories that will be deleted
Data categories that will remain
A warning that the action cannot be undone
Suggested confirmation:
Permanently delete all saved E1–E6 experiment results? This removes experiment-run outputs and associated raw responses. Policies, ground-truth annotations, configuration settings and API credentials will remain unchanged.
The user must explicitly confirm the destructive action.

Configuration Traceability Requirements

Each completed experiment run must store at least:
Configuration identifier
Configuration version
Vision model
Reasoning model
Provider
Currency treatment
Run date and time
Experiment identifier
Run identifier
A previous experiment must remain reproducible even after the active Research Configuration is changed.

Page Guide Modal

Modal Title

Research Configuration — Page Guide

Purpose

This page defines the technical configuration used to execute and compare the research experiments. Changes may affect future experiment outputs and must be controlled to preserve reproducibility.

OpenRouter API Key

Authenticates requests to the selected model provider. The key is masked, is not included in exported experiment data and must not appear in logs or error messages.

Vision Model — Layer 1

Defines the model used for OCR and document understanding in E1. Changing this setting may alter the structured data supplied to later experiments.

Reasoning Model — Layer 3

Defines the model used for policy reasoning and verdict generation in E2–E6. Changing this setting allows model-to-model comparison but also changes the experimental condition.

Currency Override

Determines whether prompts use the receipt currency or a forced AUD, USD or EUR value. The selected treatment is recorded with each affected run.

Save Settings

Stores the active research configuration for future runs and creates a traceable configuration version.

Test Connection

Checks whether the API key, provider and selected model configuration are reachable.

Export Experiment Results

Exports retained E1–E6 run data and supporting research metadata as JSON. Authentication secrets are excluded.

Delete Experiment Results

Permanently deletes saved E1–E6 outputs only after explicit confirmation. It does not delete policies, ground-truth annotations, settings or API credentials.

Why This Matters

A research result is not reproducible unless the exact technical configuration used to generate it is known. This page ensures that model choice, provider connection and currency treatment are treated as controlled research inputs rather than informal application preferences.

Data Requirements

Each saved configuration should include at least:
Configuration identifier
Configuration version
Provider name
Vision model
Reasoning model
Currency treatment
Connection-test status
Saved by
Saved timestamp
Status
The API key itself must not be included in exported configuration metadata.

Implementation Acceptance Criteria

The page is complete only when:
The page is presented as Research Configuration rather than a generic marketing-style Settings page.
The Page Guide modal explains every control.
The Vision Model options match the implemented selector.
The Reasoning Model options match the implemented selector.
The Currency Override options match the implemented selector.
Saving creates a traceable configuration version.
Every experiment result records the exact configuration used.
Connection success and failure are clearly communicated.
API keys remain masked and excluded from exports.
Export Experiment Results clearly states what is included.
Delete Experiment Results clearly states what is deleted and what remains.
Deletion requires explicit confirmation.
Policies, ground-truth annotations and configuration settings are not deleted by the results action.
The page contains no decorative top-right image or marketing-style illustration.
The page remains visually consistent with the R&D research interface.
